title: Membership Options
subtitle: Choose the plan that fits your needs.

items.title: Individual
items.content:
Perfect for adults committed to their fitness routine. Access to all branches, group classes, and aquatic facilities.

  • $29/month
  • 1 person
  • Free guest passes (2/year)

items.title: Family
items.content:
Bring everyone along. Up to 4 family members enjoy full access plus discounted youth programs.

  • $59/month
  • Up to 4 members
  • 10% off camps and programs

items.title: Senior
items.content:
For members 60+. Reduced rate, full access, plus senior fitness classes and social programs.

  • $22/month
  • 1 person, age 60+
  • Free SilverSneakers compatibility
